name: @agentproto/skill-pack-agentproto
description: @agentproto/skill-pack-agentproto — the agentproto-plugin skill pack (agent orchestration, durable supervision, adapter setup, LLM endpoints, supervisor sessions). Source of truth for both the Claude Code plugin bundle (.claude-plugin/plugin.json + skills/) and `agentproto install skill/<slug> --pack agentproto-plugin`. Edit src/skills/*, never skills/ or .claude-plugin/ directly — those are generated by `pnpm build`.
